name: Hongshanopterus
sum: Early istiodactyliform from the Aptian Jiufotang Formation of Liaoning, China.
holotype: IVPP V14582 — Jiufotang Formation, Dapingfang, Liaoning.
material: Skull and five neck vertebrae of a single individual.
biology: About 36 robust, triangular upper teeth; less specialised than later istiodactylids, which are thought to have been scavengers.
author: Wang et al. 2008

species.name: Hongshanopterus lacustris
species.author: Wang et al. 2008
